comment: A glob spilled from a destroyed box coalesces with a glob on the floor. The Priest stashes a glob of gray ooze in a wished unlocked large box, locks it with a skeleton key, drops a second glob beside it and #forces the lock with the mace. lock.c forcelock() destroys the box (seed 4285) and puts each surviving content at the hero's feet with place_object() and stackobj(); invent.c merged() then prints pudding_merge_message() ("The globs of gray ooze coalesce.") and calls mkobj.c obj_absorb().
